items.q: What kind of problem is procrastination?
items.a: An **emotion-regulation problem**, not time management: you delay to feel better now and **future you pays**.

items.q: What are the three causes of procrastination?
items.a: **Clarity** (no clear next step), **fear** (boredom, discomfort, judgment) and **inertia** (fix with a 2-minute start).

items.q: How can a productivity system backfire?
items.a: Building the **perfect system or AI rabbit hole** becomes the procrastination itself. **Simple scales, complex fails.**

items.q: What is a seasonal main quest?
items.a: For a **90-day season**, pick **one main quest for work and one for life**, plus 2–3 side quests each.

items.q: How much of your calendar should you expect to follow?
items.a: About **70–80%** is a win; a block you **keep skipping** signals it isn't your real priority.

items.q: What nearly doubled goal attainment in Gail Matthews' study?
items.a: Writing goals down and sending **weekly progress reports to a friend**: **76% vs 43%**.

items.q: What predicts success better than willpower?
items.a: **Meeting fewer temptations** in the first place; disciplined people **arrange life to need less discipline**.

items.q: What should you do after falling off a routine?
items.a: **Forgive yourself and begin again today**; self-forgiveness actually **reduces later procrastination**.
